claims.statement: Entered as no. 3 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Language, Rhetoric and Grammar. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Donato".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Ars minor. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.

sources.cite: Museo Galileo, La Biblioteca di Leonardo, record for this title.

claims.statement: Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 4th century · Printed from the 1450s.

background.text: Donatus's elementary Latin grammar; one of the five titles in the earliest list of c. 1487 to 1490.
